verdicts.reason: A shrinks the poster into the strip. The SOLSTICE wordmark, body copy, badges and legal text are microscopic and unreadable. The CTA is a small pill crowded against the right edge next to a missing-image placeholder, and the 'Sunset Sale' ribbon is tiny and floats on its own. B is the better resize. Its large serif headline and big orange 'Shop the Summer Line' CTA give a clear left-to-right hierarchy. Its flaws: the legal disclaimer is as large as the body copy, the 'Sunset Sale' tag is shrunk to a speck beside the can, a stray red placeholder fragment sits left of the headline, and the badges are tiny and scattered around the CTA.
